lines: track/c-sip rebased on main a6e14a4 (after c-reports and c-nominee): 2050360 feat(sip) backend+contracts+migration 064; ce3389f feat(admin-ui) hub section, recording link, client card; 3cd86c1 fix(sip) review follow-up (per-fund paging, ownership read, race test). Not landed.

Rebase resolutions: adminComposition keeps audit-trail, report, nominee and SIP registrations; contracts generator/index keep report, nominee and SIP operation sets; releaseUpgrade expects ...061, 062, 063, 064, 066; accountingReports harness passes sipScheduleRepository; UserDetailScreen keeps ClientNomineeSection with SipScheduleSection; generated OpenAPI and operations.ts regenerated by script at each contract commit (no hand edits, no drift at tip).

Migration 064 (expand-only, previous release ignores it): admin_sip_schedules(id,user_id,fund_id,monthly_amount_paise>0,start_month date day 1 in 2000-01..2199-12,month_count 1..600,state active|closed,created_by/updated_by,request_id,version,created/updated/closed_at; closed_at set iff closed); unique (id,user_id,fund_id); partial unique one ACTIVE schedule per (user,fund).

admin_sip_schedule_months(schedule_id,user_id,fund_id,sip_month,entry_id,created_by,request_id,created_at,released_at): composite FKs to schedules(id,user,fund) and client_value_entries(id,user,fund) RESTRICT; unique entry_id; partial unique (schedule_id,sip_month) where released_at is null.

Triggers: inserted month must be inside the schedule range; schedules refuse start_month change and month_count shrink below a live linked month; link rows refuse delete/truncate/any update except released_at null->now, and only when the linked entry has a reversal.

Reversal releases the month: reverseLedgerEntry -> releaseSipMonthOnReversal (sipMonthLink.ts) sets released_at and audits admin_sip_schedule.month_released. Schedule code never reads client_value_entries (architecture guard recurring wall unchanged).

Paid month = link with released_at null. monthsPaid, monthsDue (unpaid months from start through current IST month, 0 when closed), nextUnpaidMonth, endMonth come from pure domain/admin/sipScheduleMonths.ts scheduleProgress().
Endpoints (contract packages/contracts/src/operations/sip-schedules.ts, SIP_SCHEDULE_OPERATIONS):
GET /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/sip-schedules (client_position.write or client_values.read), unpaged.

GET /v1/admin/sip-schedules?fundId=&state=&after=&limit= (same permissions): PAGED by client full_name then schedule id, limit default 25 max 100, meta.page; signed cursor carries only the schedule id (no name in URLs), bound to fundId+state; CURSOR_INVALID on a filter change. No timestamp in the key, so keysetBoundary does not apply.

POST /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/sip-schedules (create), PATCH .../{scheduleId} (expectedVersion + optional monthlyAmountPaise, monthCount, state; reopen refused if another active), POST .../{scheduleId}/close (expectedVersion): client_position.write, required Idempotency-Key, audited admin_sip_schedule.created/updated/closed.
GET /v1/client/sip-schedules (client scope): scheduleId, fundId, fundName, monthlyAmountPaise, startMonth, totalMonths, monthsPaid, state (string).

Admin item: scheduleId,userId,clientName,fundId,fundName,monthlyAmountPaise,startMonth,endMonth,monthCount,state(string),version,monthsPaid,monthsDue,nextUnpaidMonth,paidMonths[],created/updated/closedAt.

Recording: optional body field sipScheduleLink {scheduleId, month YYYY-MM} on POST recorded-contributions; response unchanged; request hash unchanged when absent. Ownership by plain read, then schedule FOR UPDATE; monthly category, same client, same fund, active, in range, month free -> else VALIDATION_FAILED fields sipScheduleLink / sipScheduleLink.scheduleId / sipScheduleLink.month. Audited admin_sip_schedule.month_linked.

Concurrency: same-client recordings serialise on the position advisory lock, the user row lock and the schedule row lock; the schedule lock also serialises link vs schedule edit. Race test passes with any one lock; with all three removed 2 of 3 runs gave 201+500.
Receipts: sipMonth filled from the link (also for reversed receipts).

REUSE for maturity (065): domain/admin/adminSipSchedules.ts createAdminSipSchedule(tx, deps, {userId,fundId,monthlyAmountPaise bigint,startMonth,monthCount,actorUserId,requestId}) inside your transaction; closeAdminSipSchedule for the old one first (one active per user+fund). A follow-up schedule FK can reference admin_sip_schedules(id).

REUSE for payment sheet: walk GET /v1/admin/sip-schedules per fund (state=active) with the fixed load-all paged walk; it gives monthlyAmountPaise and paidMonths per client. Record each row through POST recorded-contributions with reasonCode recorded_offline_monthly_investment + sipScheduleLink {scheduleId, month}; an already-paid month returns the field error, so per-row results stay distinct. No frontend reads the per-fund list yet. No cross-fund list: add an optional query, not a new shape. No bank reference anywhere (rule-11).

Frontend reuse: features/admin/client-values/sipScheduleQueries.ts (useClientSipSchedules, create/edit/close hooks), sipMonthLink.ts (useSipMonthLink pins the month on send), users/useHeldWrite.ts + HeldWriteNotice.tsx (held-key write with Check again).

Checks at tip 3cd86c1 (Node 22 container): contracts 98 tests, OpenAPI valid, 163 ops reachable; backend check 100 files/1198; integration 52 files/494 (coverage off); frontend 32 files/303; build:client + build:admin boot checks. Backend typecheck passed on 2050360, ce3389f and 3cd86c1.

Negative controls (adminSipSchedules.integration.test.ts, run before the rebases): no month-taken check, no user scope, reversal not releasing each fail one named test; all three locks removed -> race test fails 2 of 3 runs with 500.

Conservative defaults to record in plan 0a: one active schedule per client+fund; month cap 600; months may be linked in any order incl. future months; recording date not tied to the month; amount not required to equal the schedule amount.
Not done: plan doc/section 8 (coordinator), browser/device runs, VPS.
